title: paeonia mascula var. russoi
intro: Paeonia mascula var. russoi, commonly known as the Red Peony, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of menstrual cramps, arthritis, and other conditions. The health benefits of Paeonia mascula var. russoi include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include paeonol, paeoniflorin, and paeoniflorigen, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
